name: gap-provider-retry-config
about: provider.retry 配置（model/protocol/canonical.ts ProviderRetryConfig、parseModelConfig.ts parseRetryConfig）：streamMaxRetries=0 时 500 不重试；requestMaxRetries / streamMaxRetries=1 且 baseDelayMs 很小时重试一次；retry 字段为负数时配置报错（这里只看前两种）。比较事件序列与 provider 收到的请求次数。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        requestMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
